# Personal loan (`personal-loan` v1)

An unsecured instalment loan: purpose, instalments and remaining balance.

**Group:** Retail banking · **Mnemonic:** `PLN` · **Identifiers:** `PLN-…` in `loanId`

Open one with `PLN <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: personal-loan
version: 1
description: "An unsecured instalment loan: purpose, instalments and remaining balance."
match: { kind: personal-loan, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Retail banking · Personal loan, id: $.loanId }
strip:
  - { label: Borrower, bind: $.borrowerName }
  - { label: Purpose, bind: $.purpose }
  - { label: Balance, bind: $.balance, fmt: amount2, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Instalment, bind: $.instalment, fmt: amount2 }
  - { label: Rate, bind: $.rate, fmt: pct2 }
  - { label: Days past due, bind: $.daysPastDue, fmt: amount0 }
panels:
  - id: schedule
    kind: ladder
    title: Next instalments
    key: F2
    rows: $.schedule
    columns:
      - { label: Due, bind: "@.due", fmt: date }
      - { label: Principal, bind: "@.principal", fmt: amount2 }
      - { label: Interest, bind: "@.interest", fmt: amount2 }
      - { label: Balance after, bind: "@.balance", fmt: amount2 }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.customer, 'customer')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
